description: A UI library for Compose Multiplatform

latest_release.name: v0.9.4
latest_release.body: [English](#english) | [中文](#chinese) ## Highlights - **New: `miuix-nav` module** — a self-contained Compose Multiplatform navigation runtime with continuous stack depth (`animatedTop`), slide/modal transitions, predictive back, opt-in swipe-to-dismiss, and entry lifecycle / state management. Replaces `miuix-navigation3-ui` with **zero dependency** on `androidx.navigation3`. - **New: `BreadcrumbBar` component** — horizontally scrollable capsule-shaped path segments, configurable highlighting and colors, plus `BreadcrumbItem` and `joinToPath()` helpers. - **`miuix-blur` gains progressive blur** — `Modifier.progressiveTextureBlur()`, `BackdropEffectScope.progressiveBlur()`, and `ProgressiveBlur` presets (`Top` / `Bottom` / `Left` / `Right`) provide directional blur with a sharp clear end. The gradient band and falloff curve are configurable. - **Pager gesture conflict resolution** — new `Modifier.pagerGestureOverride()` utilities let horizontal swipes switch pages while a vertical list is flinging or overscrolling. Choose native, cross-axis interception, or tap-to-halt behavior; `PagerState.springAnimateToPage()` adds spring-based page navigation. - **Navigation state and integration** — `LocalNavTransitionScope` exposes the current entry's live transition state, including `isRunning`; navigation entries now inherit the SavedState creation extras and ViewModel factory needed by `SavedStateHandle` and integrations such as Hilt. Back events are bridged across separate Android windows. - **Navigation component customization** — `NavigationBarItem` and `FloatingNavigationBarItem` gain `colors`; `NavigationRail` restores the compact selection highlight and separates fixed-layout and expandable overloads. - **More configurable dialogs** — `OverlayDialog` / `WindowDialog` gain `maxWidth`, `largeScreen`, and `cornerRadius`. Centered dialogs use a fixed 32dp default corner radius. - **Scrolling and refresh improvements** — `PullToRefresh` separates its trigger threshold from indicator scaling; `TabRow` and `TabRowWithContour` contain horizontal overscroll instead of passing it to a parent pager; overscroll and refresh handling now distinguish actual gesture sessions from wheel input. - **Platform and tooling updates** — Compose Multiplatform **1.12.0**, Kotlin **2.4.20**, Lifecycle **2.11.0**, AGP **9.4.1**, and Gradle **9.7.1**. The shared Android minimum SDK rises from 23 to **24**; `miuix-blur` continues to require API **33**. ## ⚠️ Breaking Changes ### 1. `miuix-navigation3-ui` removed, replaced by `miuix-nav` Replace the dependency and migrate the Navigation3 imports and back-stack code to the new runtime. This is not a drop-in artifact rename: `NavKey`, `rememberNavBackStack`, `NavDisplay`, and `NavController` now belong to Miuix. ```kotlin // Old dependency implementation("top.yukonga.miuix.kmp:miuix-navigation3-ui:0.9.3") // New dependency implementation("top.yukonga.miuix.kmp:miuix-nav:0.9.4") ``` ```kotlin import androidx.compose.runtime.Composable import kotlinx.serialization.Serializable import top.yukonga.miuix.kmp.nav.core.NavDisplay import top.yukonga.miuix.kmp.nav.core.NavKey import top.yukonga.miuix.kmp.nav.core.rememberNavBackStack @Serializable sealed interface Route : NavKey { @Serializable data object Home : Route } @Composable fun App() { val backStack = rememberNavBackStack(Route.Home) NavDisplay( backStack = backStack, onBack = { backStack.removeLastOrNull() }, ) { entry { HomeScreen() } } } ``` Use the route **supertype** as the explicit type argument so the whole serializable route hierarchy can be saved and restored. Swipe-to-dismiss is opt-in via `entry(swipeDismiss = …)`; built-in transition presets do not enable it automatically. Access `LocalNavTransitionScope.current` only inside a `NavDisplay` entry. See the [miuix-nav guide](https://compose-miuix-ui.githu
